title: Features for Merged SkillsFuture and Jobs Bank Portals
what_it_is: Features for Merged SkillsFuture and Jobs Bank Portals

sections.label: SkillsFuture Jobs Bank merger plans
sections.summary: The reply states ILP will have review and feedback platforms, career assessment tools, and Jobs Bank listings valid up to 30 days, rolled out from 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (a) whether the merger of the SkillsFuture and Jobs Bank portals will incorporate a review function for training providers to ensure outcome-based training provisions; (b) whether the merged portal can include internship opportunities for young Singaporeans; (c) whether the merged portal can include personality assessments that gauge the fit of the user to jobs as opposed to just skills; and (d) whether jobs listed in the Jobs Bank are regularly updated to ensure relevance.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: There will be platforms for individuals to review and provide feedback on the training programmes available on ILP, and information on training outcomes will be published on the portal.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: As internship opportunities are managed by the respective Institutes of Higher Learning, ILP is currently not built with such a feature.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: ILP will also have tools and resources that will enable individuals to assess their career interests, skills gaps and work values.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Besides discovering one's career interest and identifying skills gaps, individuals can also view and apply for jobs via the Jobs Bank, which will be integrated into ILP.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Jobs listed in the Jobs Bank are regularly updated as each job posting is only valid for a maximum period of 30 days.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Job postings that have expired are automatically removed.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: ILP will be rolled out in stages, starting from 2017, and we will share more details in due course.
